Theorem 1001 (Chapter 129)

Subject: lattice problems | ID: 31120

Proposition

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every orthogonal solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the diagonalizable operator \(B_{012910011}\) acting on the metric space. By the diagonalizable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{012910011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012910011\).

Step 2. By compactness of the continuous spectral family \(W_{012910012}\), the image is precompact in the Besov space topology.

Step 3. The continuous functional \(\Phi_{012910013}\) on the polish space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{012910013}\| \leq C_012910013\) by the continuous embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via iterative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
